canon_ref.note: About fifteen tribes, two weeks north (day is a guess). Flashback: Rags hit a Goblin Lord warband attacking an unnamed Human city; Garen says his full army is tens of thousands. The text says Rockjaw tribe; our data keeps Jawbreaker (2.19G).

b4.redfang_coalition_reaches_tremborags_.summary: After nearly two weeks marching north, Rags and Garen's coalition of High Passes tribes reaches a lone mountain near Invrisil. Inside an old Dwarf city the Great Chieftain Tremborag rules thousands of Goblins. He agrees to an alliance, mostly to keep Garen's key from the Goblin Lord.

canon_ref.note: Tremborag speaks fluent common and says he met the Goblin King Velan the Kind about ten years ago. A few other chieftains also stay on their feet.

b4.rags_refuses_to_kneel_to_tremborag.summary: In his hall Tremborag uses a Skill that drives the gathered chieftains to their knees. Rags stays standing. The Great Chieftain notes it and lets it pass for now.

canon_ref.note: Only the Gold Stone Chieftain (later Pyrite), the young Still Grass Chieftain and three Hobs stand up for her. The Hob Garen strikes does not get up; the text does not say he died.

b4.garen_fells_rags_at_tremborags_feast.summary: At the feast Rags kicks a Hob out of the seat of honour, and Garen, now the real leader of the coalition, knocks her down in front of everyone. Few Goblins take her side. Rags decides this mountain is not a true Goblin home.

system.name: [Warrior]
system.note: Gained levels on the march; no number given.

system.name: [Leader]
system.note: Ten or more levels on the march; she senses it will soon become [Chieftain].
